text:
jen: Heads-up — planning to cut the engine/kernel update (kernel v2.3.4 + quant bundle v12) in the midnight UTC change window (00:30 UTC). Posting the safety checklist and rollback criteria here. Please ack if you’ll be around for the +/− 1h window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created by jen at 2026-05-04T00:30:00Z.
Commit: `a7f4c9d`
Targets: engine:2.3.4, quant-bundle:12, matmul-kernel:v3.1
Slices: 10% -> 30% -> 100% over 20m intervals
Preflight: queued (smoke -> perf -> thermal)

kai: Are we still using the regional stagger? want to keep EU small first (10%). Also what’s the pin TTL if we need to freeze?

jen: Yes EU-first. Pin TTL is 2h by default for deploybot pins. If you need longer, use `deploybot pin --ttl 24h` and add a manual follow-up.

maria: Can someone paste the release note blurb I can push to the portal? Need small bullets and known incompatibilities.

ryan: Telemetry gates: I want P95 latency, error-rate, GPU OOM count, and KV-cache-miss ratio. Proposed thresholds:
- p95 increase > 30% over baseline -> hold/rollback
- absolute error rate +0.5% -> hold/rollback
- GPU OOMs > 0.1% of requests for 5m -> rollback
- KV-cache-miss increase > 15% sustained 10m -> investigate (may be cache invalidation)

jen: Agree. Also add model-quality smoke: perplexity on canary prompt set not worse than 2% and no hallucination surge on top-10 prompts.

samir: Ran the quick matmul smoke locally against engine:2.3.4 + quant v12. Paste of the tail logs:```\n[smoke-run] init ok\n[smoke-run] matmul kernel load v3.1 ok\n[smoke-run] perf median 14ms (baseline 13ms)\n[smoke-run] p95 62ms (baseline 48ms)  <-- flagged but running on dev HW\n[smoke-run] no OOMs\n```\nNoted p95 on dev is higher; gating on perf in staging looks necessary.

jen: Good catch — we’ll require a staging perf snapshot within 12h of the rollout. If staging p95 > baseline +25% we stop.

deploy-bot: Preflight results: smoke OK, perf snapshot pending, thermal probe OK.

maria: Release notes draft: "Engine 2.3.4: Performance and kernel maintenance. Includes updated quantization kernels (quant-bundle v12) with better throughput for long-context workloads. Known issues: slight p95 variance observed in small-dev GPUs; monitoring enabled. Contact eng-runtime if you observe regression."

jen: Add the rollback playbook bullets: how to pin and emergency rollback commands. Put exact commands in the playbook. Example commands:```\n# pin current stable\ndeploybot pin engine:2.3.3 --reason "rollback pin"\n# rollback whole slice\ndeploybot rollback --to engine:2.3.3 --slice 30%\n# abort rollout\ndeploybot abort --id a7f4c9d\n```\nAlso include comms: Ping #incidents if customer-facing errors > 0.2% sustained 10m.

kai: One more: for TTL pins, ops will need to run `deploybot unpin --force` if we later clear. I'll be on call and can run that. :thumbsup:

ryan: Where are we surfacing the metrics dashboard? I’ll watch the per-route p95 and error rate. Link to dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/engine/cutovers/a7f4c9d (staging + prod panels).

samir: Quick note — the quant bundle includes a fallback path for matmul with different kernel name `matmul_compat`. If fallback triggers >1% we should escalate; might indicate kernel ABI mismatch on older cards.

jen: Excellent — add that to the gating: fallback-trigger >1% for 10m => rollback.

deploy-bot: Perf snapshot posted: staging p95 +12% vs baseline (within threshold). Proceeding to EU 10% slice at T+0.

maria: Pushed release note to portal, added contact cjeng and eng-runtime alias.

kai: EU slice green at 10% after 10m. No OOMs, error delta +0.03%. continuing to 30%.

deploy-bot: 30% slice applied. Monitoring 5m window.

jen: I’m watching metrics; if anyone sees p95 spike or increased OOMs call it out loudly.

ryan: 5m check: p95 +8% (normalizing), errors +0.04%. No action.

samir: Getting a single host with `matmul_compat` fallback at 0.6% traffic — within gate but keep an eye.

jen: OK — flagging the host for manual remediation after cutover. Not rolling back for a single host yet.

kai: 30->100% in progress. ETA 18m.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 100% at 2026-05-04T00:58:00Z. Post-rollout smoke scheduled in 5m.

ryan: Post-rollout 10m check: p95 +10%, errors +0.05%, GPU OOMs none, KV-cache-miss +3%. All within thresholds.

maria: Not seeing customer tickets yet. Will standby.

jen: Great job team. Leaving a note: if we do need to rollback later, use the pinned commit flow and open an incident so we can coordinate cross-team comms. I'll update the release notes with the final metrics tomorrow.

kai: Acknowledged. I’ll follow up on the flagged host tomorrow morning.

samir: TL;DR: rollout completed, one host fallback signal at 0.6%, staging perf looked fine.

deploy-bot: Closing rollout ticket a7f4c9d. :white_check_mark:

jen: Thanks everyone — closing thread. If anything crops up overnight, ping eng-oncall."
